meta.title: Introduce UID support for Messages to enable efficient frontend tracking
meta.body_summary: Add content-based UIDs (later refactored to Symfony UUID v5) to message types and MessageBag for efficient frontend sync by avoiding redundant data transfer.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot introduced content-based UIDs initially with SHA256, then refactored to Symfony UUID v5 per review; closed later in favor of PR #364 without merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 626 changed lines, this is a medium-sized edit by absolute volume, concentrated in message classes and a 300‑line test suite. It fits a feature‑addition PR that was closed without merge in favor of an alternative implementation.

review_details.concern_detail: chr-hertel requested reworking `getUid()` to `getId()` returning `Symfony\Component\Uid\Uuid` and OskarStark flagged a missing newline; Copilot refactored to UUID v5 with a fixed namespace, fixed the newline, and addressed code‑style issues.
review_details.performance_claim: Efficient frontend sync by avoiding redundant data transfer using message UIDs.
review_details.rejection_signals: Closed in favor of alternative PR #364 after addressing all review comments; no performance or correctness rejection.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The Agent’s initial custom SHA256 approach was redirected by maintainers to the existing Symfony UID library. It successfully refactored to UUID v5, demonstrating adaptability to framework conventions.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainers chr‑hertel and OskarStark reviewed the UID generation approach and requested switching to the Symfony UID component.
detection_detail.ci_auto: chr‑hertel asked to run `make cs` and `make ci` to fix code style and check pipeline tools, though firewall restrictions limited full execution.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Comprehensive test suite covers UID determinism and MessageBag methods, but no performance benchmarks or before/after timing data are provided for the claimed sync improvement.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No performance regression occurred; the PR was closed in favor of a different implementation without merging.

core_change_summary.description: Added `getId()` returning `Symfony\Component\Uid\Uuid` (initially `getUid()` with SHA256) to `MessageInterface` and all message types. Enhanced `MessageBag` and `MessageBagInterface` with UID‑based lookup and filtering methods (`findByUid`, `hasMessageWithUid`, `getUids`, `messagesAfterUid`, `messagesNewerThan`).
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test file was renamed from MessageUidTest.php to MessageIdTest.php after the switch to `getId()`; covers deterministic UIDs and MessageBag operations.
change_trajectory: Initial plan and implementation with `getUid()` using SHA256 hash.
Review feedback: use Symfony UID component and `getId()` returning `Uuid`.
Refactored to use UUID v5 with a fixed namespace; updated all classes and tests.
Addressed code‑style issues (trailing whitespace, missing newline) per maintainer requests.
PR closed by maintainer in favor of another PR (#364) after ~4 days.

review_signals.action_taken: Copilot refactored to UUID v5 in commit b16b76a.
